title: A Mousetrap: Fooling Large Reasoning Models for Jailbreak with Chain of Iterative Chaos
reasoning: The paper describes a jailbreak attack methodology (Mousetrap) designed to bypass the safety alignment of Large Reasoning Models. Although the dataset used (TROTTER) contains prompts related to harmful content like hate speech against religious minorities, the research focuses on the technical mechanics of the attack and its success rate on safety benchmarks, rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or philosophical ethical frameworks.
